Harpoon guns (And other ranged weaponry) no longer log hits from players
body:
This is really easy to fix though I don't have a branch to make a pull request from on this right now (I'll set something up for submitting bug fixes at some point).

In Rangedweapon.cs's Use (Which fires the projectile) it calls the projectile's use function.
Before doing this it sets the User of the projectile however this should also be included in the Use send (as character will be equal to null, and then the user is set from character on use, setting the user to null)

Simple fix is in Barotrauma Shared -> Items -> Components -> Holdable -> RangedWeapon -> line 114
Projectile.Use(deltaTime); -> Projectile.Use(deltaTime, character);

title: In the roguelike keyset, no keypress or command works to toggle squelch.
body:
**Reported by myshkin on 18 Sep 2012 02:58 UTC**
Reported on IRC by tlp. The problem is that, for the roguelike keyset, cmd0.c assigns KTRL('G') to both toggling squelch and doing autopickup, and the latter wins in cmd_init(). As a consequence, not even keymaps can assign a keypress to the command to toggle squelch. I propose changing the default roguelike keypress for this to O, which is currently unused. Unfortunately, there is no workaround for 3.4.0 users, other than recompiling.

The topology tools were [recently updated](https://github.com/RPTools/maptool/issues/4027) to use the term "isometric rectangle" for the diamond-shaped tools. Meanwhile the analogous drawing tool and FoW tool still use the term "diamond" where "isometric rectangle" would be more appropriate.

### To Reproduce

Hover over the rightmost drawing tool and see the tooltip:
> Draw a _diamond_.

Hover over the rightmost FoW tool and see the tooltip
> Expose/Hide a _diamond_ on the Fog of War.

### Expected Behaviour

The cases above should read:
> Draw an _isometric rectangle_.

and

> Expose/Hide an _isometric rectangle_ on the Fog of War.
